# Frozen RC.1 distribution fixture

These unmodified test fixtures are copied from release source
`9d9ed9744c29a494d45501a8bb1359edd465c5c4` (`v0.1.0-rc.1`).
The foundation regression test hashes these files against the real frozen pins;
its other tests use independent synthetic payloads. This directory is test data,
not an installation or current candidate package. The accompanying GPL-3.0
licence and module notices are retained.
